dp_limit_pa.note: one high-dp design is the largest thermal passer everywhere, so the allocation can only bind by heat level (0, 9, 18 or 27 of 27 strata); under the registered selection (lowest dp among PASS) an allocation removes high-dp designs but never changes the best
dp_limit_pa.rationale: median over strata of the largest dp among thermally passing designs: the allocation excludes a thermally adequate design in about half the strata (B's 25 kPa never bound)

lid_t_mm.rationale: largest thickness where the median design's ratio-2 vs ratio-1.5 peak differs by >= 1.0 K (B's 3 mm gives -0.05 K)

low_heat_w.rationale: smallest step up from B's 900 W at which no stratum passes more than 80% thermally

derived_from: point B's 96 cell solves (~carbon/runs/cpb, plan sha256 dc11be08...) by scripts/dev/cold_plate/point_c.py; no new solves
independence: C's values are tuned on B's outcomes: its value check is a calibration, not out-of-sample evidence
status: DEVELOPMENT stress stratum (Test Lead 2026-10-11, dev autonomy); adoption into the frozen envelope is the owner's
unchanged_from_B: inlets 37/40/42 C, ratios 1/1.5/2 (worse of the central and outlet bands), 1,000 and 1,100 W, flow 1.5 L/min/kW, TIM2 5e-6, limit 85 C, lid k 2,000/5,000/10,000 as a sensitivity
